To whom it may concern at tarbiyatulquran.org,

We are writing to let you know that tarbiyatulquran.com is currently on the market. As the owner of tarbiyatulquran.org, we thought you might be interested in acquiring tarbiyatulquran.com to complete your online presence.

Details about tarbiyatulquran.com (including how to submit an offer) are available here:

https://domainlions.net/domains/tarbiyatulquran.com?id=oyak

If you are not interested, please consider this a one-time notification.
 
Kind regards,
David Pavel
Domain Acquisition Team, Domain Lions LLC
